Download Reference Annotations and Sequences

Source: R/download_reference.R
download_reference.Rd

Downloads annotation (GFF3/GTF) and sequence (transcript or genome FASTA) files from the main public providers:

  • "gencode" (default): any GENCODE release for human (GRCh38) or mouse (GRCm39), including future releases.

  • "ensembl": any Ensembl release, for any species of any division (vertebrates, plants, metazoa, fungi, protists).

  • "ncbi": any NCBI assembly by accession (for example GCF_009914755.1 for T2T-CHM13v2.0, GCF_000001405.40 for GRCh38.p14).

  • "t2t": shorthand for reference = "ncbi", accession = "GCF_009914755.1" (telomere-to-telomere T2T-CHM13v2.0).

  • "mane": MANE (Matched Annotation from NCBI and EMBL-EBI) releases, the canonical transcript per protein-coding gene, in Ensembl or RefSeq coordinates and identifiers.

  • "fantom": the FANTOM CAT transcriptome assembly (Hon et al. 2017; GRCh37/hg19) at one of its levels (version = "lv3_robust" by default; "lv1_raw", "lv2_permissive", "lv4_stringent"), GTF only. FANTOM6 analyses use the lv3 robust catalog. The companion ID mapping, gene information and CAGE cluster tables come from download_fantom_cat_tables().

Instead of assuming file names, the function lists the release directory on the server and picks the matching file, so new releases and new genome patch versions (for example GRCh38.p15) work without a package update. Files already present in output_path are not downloaded again. Any other file reachable by URL (for example the T2T consortium Liftoff GFF3 files) can be cached the same way with download_reference_url(), and HPRC per-haplotype annotations with download_hprc_annotation().

Usage

download_reference(
  version = NULL,
  reference = c("gencode", "ensembl", "ncbi", "t2t", "mane", "fantom"),
  organism = c("human", "mouse"),
  file_type = c("gff", "gtf", "fasta", "ncrna_fasta", "genome_fasta", "polya"),
  region = c("all", "chr", "primary"),
  species = NULL,
  division = c("vertebrates", "plants", "metazoa", "fungi", "protists"),
  accession = NULL,
  mane_source = c("ensembl", "refseq"),
  output_path = ":cache:",
  timeout_limit = 3600,
  method = "auto"
)

Arguments

version

Release version. GENCODE: the release number ("49", 49, or "M38" / "38" for mouse; default "49"). Ensembl: the release number ("116"); NULL (default) uses the current release. MANE: "1.5"; NULL uses the current release. NCBI/T2T: ignored (the accession identifies the assembly version).

reference

One of "gencode", "ensembl", "ncbi", "t2t", "mane", "fantom".

organism

"human" (default) or "mouse". For Ensembl it sets the default species (homo_sapiens / mus_musculus).

file_type

"gff" (default), "gtf", "fasta" (transcript sequences; for Ensembl the cdna.all file), "ncrna_fasta" (Ensembl non-coding transcript sequences), "genome_fasta" (genome sequence; not provided by MANE) or "polya" (GENCODE manually annotated poly(A) sites and signals, polyAs.gff3.gz; see polya_sites()).

region

Annotation flavour: "all" (default; reference chromosomes, patches, haplotypes and scaffolds), "chr" (reference chromosomes only) or "primary" (primary assembly). For file_type = "genome_fasta", "primary" selects the primary assembly genome and the other values the full patched / toplevel genome. Ignored for NCBI and MANE.

species

Ensembl species name in lower snake case ("homo_sapiens", "arabidopsis_thaliana"). Defaults from organism.

division

Ensembl division: "vertebrates" (default, the main Ensembl site), "plants", "metazoa", "fungi" or "protists".

accession

NCBI assembly accession (GCF_... or GCA_...), required for reference = "ncbi".

mane_source

Identifier space of MANE files: "ensembl" (default) or "refseq".

output_path

Directory where the file is saved. Defaults to ":cache:", the package cache (see get_isoformic_cache()).

timeout_limit

Maximum time in seconds for the download. Takes precedence over options("timeout"). Defaults to 3600.

method

Method used by utils::download.file(). Defaults to "auto".

Value

The full path to the downloaded (or already present) file.

Errors

The function fails early with a specific condition class:

  • isoformic_download_reference_no_internet_error: no connection.

  • isoformic_download_reference_release_not_found_error: the release (or species, assembly) directory does not exist; for GENCODE the message lists the latest available releases.

  • isoformic_download_reference_file_not_found_error: the release exists but has no file of the requested type; the message lists the candidate files found.

  • isoformic_download_reference_error: the transfer failed or produced an empty file (partial files are removed).

Matching annotation and sequences

Salmon indices must be built from the transcript FASTA of the same provider and release as the annotation directory, so that transcript IDs match: GENCODE FASTA headers are |-separated (handled by ignore_after_bar), Ensembl cdna.all headers carry the versioned transcript ID first, NCBI rna.fna headers carry the RefSeq accession, and MANE provides both identifier spaces. For lifted annotations (T2T consortium Liftoff, HPRC CAT) extract the FASTA from the assembly with gffread -w transcripts.fa -g assembly.fa annotation.gff3.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
# GENCODE
gff_file <- download_reference(version = "49", file_type = "gff")
gtf_file <- download_reference(version = "50", file_type = "gtf", region = "chr")
gff_file_mouse <- download_reference(version = "M38", organism = "mouse")
genome_file <- download_reference(version = "49", file_type = "genome_fasta")

# Ensembl: current human release, Arabidopsis from Ensembl Plants
ens_gff <- download_reference(reference = "ensembl")
ens_cdna <- download_reference(reference = "ensembl", file_type = "fasta")
ath_gff <- download_reference(
  reference = "ensembl", division = "plants", species = "arabidopsis_thaliana"
)

# NCBI assemblies by accession, and the T2T-CHM13v2.0 shorthand
t2t_gff <- download_reference(reference = "t2t", file_type = "gff")
t2t_fasta <- download_reference(reference = "t2t", file_type = "fasta")
grch38_gff <- download_reference(reference = "ncbi", accession = "GCF_000001405.40")

# MANE canonical transcripts (Ensembl identifiers)
mane_gff <- download_reference(reference = "mane", file_type = "gff")
c(gff_file, gtf_file, gff_file_mouse, genome_file, ens_gff, ens_cdna,
  ath_gff, t2t_gff, t2t_fasta, grch38_gff, mane_gff)
} # }
